Name: Fadester for OBS
Description: Direct OBS source browsing, show/hide, scenes, transitions, mixer fades, and optional creative layer controls. Midi Fadester integration is optional.

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-neo-.Name: OBS Scene Info Bar
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-neo-.Tooltip: Display OBS connection, live scene, and Studio Mode preview on the Stream Deck Neo Info Bar.

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.layer-co.Name: Source & Layer
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.layer-co.Tooltip: Browse existing scene sources and show or hide the deck-selected source. Creative controls add blend modes and optional layer reordering.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Browse sources, blend modes, or explicitly enabled layer order
TriggerDescription.Push: Show/hide source, or reset blend to Normal
TriggerDescription.Touch: Show/hide source, or reset blend to Normal

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-fade.Name: OBS Fader
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-fade.Tooltip: Adjust an audio source, or blend the Live scene into Next with the colorful scene mixer.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Adjust audio volume, or blend Live into Next
TriggerDescription.Push: Run the press action chosen in settings

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.scene-tr.Name: Scene & Transition
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.scene-tr.Tooltip: Select next or previous OBS scene, cut, preview, or run a chosen transition.

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-fade.Name: OBS Fade
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-fade.Tooltip: Directly fade an OBS mixer input up or down without changing scene-transition settings.

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.fader.Name: Midi Fadester Fader (optional)
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.fader.Tooltip: Optional enhanced control for an existing Midi Fadester slot.

TriggerDescription.Push: Run press action (hold 0.8 s for hold action)
TriggerDescription.Touch: Tap to jump or snap to side

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.auto-fad.Name: Midi Fadester Auto-fade (optional)
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.auto-fad.Tooltip: Optional enhanced fade for an existing Midi Fadester slot.
